name: Question 6
problem:
The Taylor series for the function $f(x)$ about $x=3$ is given by

$$
f(x)={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }(-1)^{n+1}\frac{n(x-3)^{n}}{n+3}.
$$

Find ${a}_{n},$ given that

$$
{f}^{′}(x)={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }(-1)^{n+1}{a}_{n}.
$$

Question 6
?

The Taylor series for the function f(x) about x=3 is given by f(x)=∑n=1∞(−1)n+1n(x−3)nn+3. Find an, given that

f′(x)=∑n=1∞(−1)n+1an.

a
an=n2(x−3)n−1n+3
b
an=n(x−3)n−1n+3
c
an=n2(x−3)nn+3
d
an=n(x−3)nn+3
e
an=(x−3)n−1n+3
Submit
